generalTip: Dodge his Q sweet spots. His sustain is weaker early if you avoid the blade.
earlyGame: His Q is strong but cooldowns are long. Trade when his Q is down.
midGame: He roams effectively with ult. Ward river and match his roams.
lateGame: Falls off against tanks. Peel him off your backline.
matchupNote: Build anti-heal early. Fight inside his Q range to make it harder for him to hit the edge.
